<a id="description">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>description</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.lang.String description</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The description of the location.
 In general, the language can't be bound to the description.
 Usually, the language is one of the local languages of the incident region.
 Note: A localizable description of the incident is part of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficincidentbase#getDescription()"><code>TrafficIncidentBase.getDescription()</code></a>.
 This description describes only the location where the incident occurred.
 Defaults to an empty string.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="polyline">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>polyline</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoPolyline</a> polyline</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The polyline representing the traffic entity shape.
 The current field contains a continuous polyline with no gaps between geo-coordinates.
 All others following the gap are present in the <code>additional_polylines</code> field.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="additionalPolylines">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>additionalPolylines</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoPolyline</a>&gt; additionalPolylines</pre>
<div class="block"><p>List of polylines that were not included in continuous polyline.
 Use this to fill any gaps in the continuous polyline.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="lengthInMeters">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>lengthInMeters</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;int lengthInMeters</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The affected road length in meters.
 The length can be 0 only if the incident supplier has provided incomplete data.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
